entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I'm calling about an order I placed last month. I'd like to make a return.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number?
Sure. The name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF77491.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the AeroFlow Helmet. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It’s definitely a preference issue. The helmet itself seems fine, but the color isn't quite what I expected from the pictures on the site. The box is still unopened, so it's in brand new condition.
I understand. Sometimes the on-screen color can vary slightly. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. I see the item was delivered 37 days ago. One moment.

Okay, Alex, good news. I've checked our knowledge base, and you are well within the 90-day window for a standard return. I can go ahead and approve that for you and email you a pre-paid shipping label.
That's great to hear. Thank you. Since I am going to be ordering a replacement, is there any chance you could provide a small discount code for the hassle of the return? Even 10% would be helpful.

I can definitely process the full refund for you, but I'm afraid I'm not authorized to issue discount codes for preference-based returns. Our primary focus is ensuring rider safety and product integrity, and getting your refund processed smoothly.
I see. I was just hoping for a little something since I do plan to buy the same helmet in a different color. No flexibility on that?

I appreciate you choosing VeloFit for your gear. While I can't add a credit, I can assure you the return will be quick and easy. Shall I send that return label to the email on file, alex.chen@email.com?
Alright, that works. Yes, please send the label to that email. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome, Alex. The email is on its way. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a safe ride.
